meta.title: All Vendors: The search field accepts letters, numbers, special characters, and very long text
gaps: Precisely record how the vendor list changes for each search value without a stated expected result
Determine an unspecified validation response beyond whether the typed value remains in the field
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Precisely record how the vendor list changes for each search value without a stated expected result; Determine an unspecified validation response beyond whether the typed value remains in the field

steps.note: Open the events list to reach the saved draft.
Confirm the events list rendered successfully.
Open the Drafts tab as required by the case.
Open the first saved draft, which returns to its create screen.
Open the draft's All Vendors window.
Confirm the All Vendors window opened.
Enter the mixed letters, numbers, and special characters.
Verify the first search value was accepted by the field.
Check that reviewing the first search produced no crash or server error.
Replace the field with a long mixed-character search value to test acceptance or shortening.
Confirm the long value remains represented in the field; this also exposes shortening or rejection.
Check that the long search produces no crash, server error, or page corruption.
